aaliyah-puglia.summary: Aaliyah is a 24-year-old chef from Gloucester City, New Jersey, now living in Providence. She describes herself as confident, wise, and sporadic, and a life of sudden moves — Jersey to Miami at 13, then college in Rhode Island, then solo travel for work — has made her comfortable with change. She came for the title.
bullets: Chef who moved to Miami at 13 with little warning
Identifies with Yam Yam, hoped to play like Cirie
Voted out Day 3 in 21st place after her plan reached Brady
First known contestant raised by same-sex parents

alexis-levine.summary: Alexis is a criminal defense attorney from Atlanta who's used to fighting from the bottom and thinking creatively. Outgoing, thoughtful, and determined, she draws strength from ten years of sobriety and from her daughter, Lyla. She values alliance partners who think differently than she does.
bullets: Defends the little guy against the government for a living
Proudest accomplishment: 10 years of sobriety
Iranian on her father's side, and hopes to visit one day
Gardens, reads, and walks with her husband, daughter, and two poodles

ana-sani.summary: Ana is a Toronto voice actress who has lent her voice to more than 60 animated shows, plus commercials, audiobooks and video games. She calls herself goofy, ambitious and chaotic, loves games of all kinds, and plays for her mom, a fellow Survivor fan. Her game ended on Day 5 in 20th place.
bullets: Honors degree in Political Science, focused on political theory and power
Named Linnea and Sharonda, covered it up badly, and got blindsided
Gym rat, pianist, coffee shop explorer and League of Legends player
Pet peeves: transition lenses, subway door-blockers, and cheaters of all kinds

brady-booker.summary: Brady is a 27-year-old pro wrestler who grew up watching Survivor with his family. He loves the outdoors, competition, and being pushed to his limit, and he values trust above all in an alliance. Enthusiastic, intense, and fun, he says he's comfortable being uncomfortable.
bullets: Wrestles under the ring name Bodhi Hayward
Did gymnastics throughout his youth sports years
Hunts, fishes, hikes, lifts, runs trails, and trains jujitsu
Finished 13th on Survivor 51, voted out 9–4

carter-krull.summary: Carter is a 24-year-old livestock farmer from Rock Rapids, Iowa, who describes himself as adventurous, competitive and determined. He's a builder by nature — a snow cone truck, a moving company, epoxy river tables — and credits his parents for teaching him to work hard and chase things down. Survivor has been on his bucket list for a while.
bullets: Co-founded a cross-country moving company named MOVE MOVE MOVE
Makes epoxy river tables, inspired by a grandpa who built his own house
Youngest member of Savu and youngest man in Survivor 51
Third player ever to accept the chance to mutiny

cristian-chavez.summary: Cristian is a 26-year-old head of HR from Salt Lake City who calls himself fun, chaotic and loud. He grew up running homemade Survivor challenges with his dad, earned a master's degree at 21, and is a devoted father whose biggest inspiration is his mom. He loves competition and wants a partner whose motives he can predict.
bullets: Was an alternate for Survivor 47
Earned his master's degree at 21
Bakes, studies philosophy, and feeds ducks in his free time
Loves animals, hates worms, and has a very loud laugh

danny-kilby.summary: Kilby is a 30-year-old game designer from Mount Forest, Ontario, who has loved Survivor since childhood and met most of his closest people — including his girlfriend — through the fandom. He's a wacky, playful strategist who leads with good vibes, big energy, and genuine warmth.
bullets: First in his family to finish high school and attend university
Proudest moment: his mom earning her own degree after he did
Wants to hear your real laugh before trusting you
Hobbies range from improv and karaoke to Lego, dodgeball, and WWE

devin-way.summary: Devin is an actor from Lufkin, Texas, now living in Los Angeles, and he's simply thrilled to be here. He's charming, playful, and loyal, guided by his grandmother MoeMoe and a weekly D&D habit that taught him to roll the dice and figure it out.
bullets: Seventh of 13 siblings — something you'd never guess looking at him
Plays Dungeons & Dragons weekly; also loves line dancing and karaoke
Wants Rick Devens' joy, identifies with Joe's integrity and family love
Had the very first confessional of Survivor 51

eric-macksoud.summary: Eric is a mental health counselor who sees Survivor as a celebration of the human experience and a chance to test himself. He builds bonds fast, leans on emotional intelligence, and plans to be upfront about his feelings. Animated, charismatic, and genuinely curious about what makes people tick.
bullets: Community theater regular who makes close friends with every new cast
Trained in Muay Thai and swam competitively from age 8 through college
Passed his counseling licensing exam on the fourth try and still draws pride from it
Models his game on Domenick Abbate: charming, honest, calculated risks

jelly-loblack.summary: Angelica "Jelly" Loblack is a 29-year-old sociology professor who grew up watching Survivor with family and turned those questions into a career. She earned her PhD before 30 and sees her training in observation and analysis as her sharpest tool. Curious, warm, and ready to debate anything.
bullets: Afro-Caribbean and Choctaw descent, from Garland, TX, now living in Bloomington, IN
Won most comedic mascot at mascot camp as Webber the Bear
Her grandma — queer trailblazer and two-time breast cancer survivor — is her biggest inspiration
Pet peeves: bragging, black-and-white thinking, and loud eaters

jenna-doore.summary: Jenna is a Toledo wedding photographer who has watched Survivor with her family since she was seven. Empathetic, determined, and energetic, she reads as the sweet artistic type but keeps a strategic side tucked behind the camera. She values genuine connection over convenience, and plays for the people cheering her on.
bullets: Bought her first camera at 15 with babysitting money
Put a 'Survivor Clause' in her wedding contracts for five years
Gave away 154 poems in exchange for hearing people's dreams
Blindsided 4–1 on Savu, finishing 17th

kristin-flickinger.summary: Kristin has been applying to Survivor since the middle of season one, and she arrives at 49 as the oldest player of the season. A crisis management professional from Idaho now living in Santa Barbara, she channels her own hard experiences into serving the LGBTQ+ community. Determined and joyful, she wants an alliance partner who'll get up to mischief with her.
bullets: Built an intergenerational culinary arts program for LGBTQ+ youth and seniors
Carries rocks in her bra, chosen by mood and by the day's meetings
Identifies with Rachel LaMont: quirky, smart, innovative and a little lucky
Decided long ago to be her own inspiration

lewis-kelly.summary: Lewis is a 28-year-old farmer from Dublin who now lives in Puerto Rico with his wife, Andrea, in a school bus they renovated together. Becoming a US citizen pushed him to apply, and he arrives cheeky and self-aware, happy to play the fool while thinking a few steps ahead.
bullets: First Irish castaway to compete on Survivor
Lives in a school bus he and his wife renovated themselves
Calls lying a hobby and says snitches get their torches snuffed
Credits a trip to North Korea as practice for isolation and uncertainty

linnea-capobianco.summary: Linnea is a 25-year-old entrepreneur from Kearny, New Jersey, who runs her own business in NYC. She describes herself as rational, outgoing, and optimistic, and says she wants to say yes to challenges and be uncomfortable so she can grow. Her time studying and working in Washington, D.C. taught her that relationships are everything.
bullets: Shoots street photography and goes to jazz shows in her free time
Values alliance partners who stay rational and don't get paranoid
Gets uncontrollable laughing fits at the worst possible moments
Inspired by war photographer Lynsey Addario, a voice for the voiceless

maggie-nestor.summary: Maggie is a 40-year-old farmer from West Virginia who has watched Survivor since she was 15. She describes herself as joyful, intentional, and redneck, and she's proudest of the life she and her husband built with their three kids. Her faith and her home state shape everything she does.
bullets: Farms, fishes, hunts, pole vaults, plays guitar, and teaches
First castaway to live in West Virginia during filming
Oldest member of the original Toka tribe
First to hold two Extra Votes, then gave both away at once

mike-pinsky.summary: Mike is a 32-year-old baseball executive from New York City who has loved Survivor since playing it in apartment hallways at age 8. He carries his late mother's words — everyone has something to offer — into the game, and values allies who bring him information above all.
bullets: Proposed to his wife Becky using a Jeff Probst catchphrase
First kissed Becky on stage in A Midsummer Night's Dream
Home cook, pickup basketball player, and owner of a dachshund named Pookie
Pet peeves: misused words, overused words, under-seasoned food

ori-jean-charles.summary: Ori is a 27-year-old personal trainer and former Division I football player from Spring Valley, NY, who plays for his family above all. Calm, physically strong, and relentlessly hardworking, he describes himself as consistent, an anomaly, and a hustler. His mom is his best friend and the reason he's here.
bullets: Drove 8 hours home every weekend in college after his mom's back injury
First in his family to earn a degree — then added a master's
Played First Chair violin in his sixth grade orchestra
Loves food, travel, and being the best-dressed guy in the room

patt-cannaday.summary: Patt is a federal prosecutor from Tampa who describes herself as goofy, loyal, and intense. She chases adventures she's unprepared for and gets through them on friendship, which is also how she approaches Survivor. She wants allies willing to take risks and join in a little shenanigans.
bullets: Boxes, skydives, hikes, and hosts dramatic reading nights
Got lost on a six-hour Brazil hike that ended as a climb in the dark
Proudest of her marriage; credits her homeschooling mom and Air Force dad
Pet peeve: the least informed person telling everyone else what to do

rob-antonson.summary: Rob is a Rhode Island gate agent and dad of three who calls himself a city boy, not an outdoors type. He came to Survivor to show his kids that stepping outside your comfort zone is worth it. Warm, funny, and competitive, he treats airport chaos as training for island chaos.
bullets: Found a Hidden Immunity Idol early on the losing Savu tribe
First player to voluntarily try voting for himself at Tribal Council
Withdrew at 19th over a foot cut, though medically cleared to stay
Reality TV junkie, karaoke singer, and coach of his sons' teams

sharonda-cox.summary: Sharonda is an OB/GYN resident who grew up in a single-parent household in Pompano Beach and now calls Kentucky home. She plays for her family and for kids from places like hers, hoping to meet a newer, more unapologetic version of herself. Warm, steady, and used to working for everything.
bullets: Was first chair violin in orchestra and played at Disney
Science nerd who loved NASA, long before medical school
Credits her grandparents, who left school to work bean fields
Wants alliance partners who are loyal but can pivot before tribal

thien-an-nguyen.summary: An Nguyen, who goes by Thien An, is a 24-year-old medical student from Fort Worth and the youngest castaway of Survivor 51. Quick-witted and warm, he's drawn to the raw, authentic side of the game — new friends and the outdoors. His parents are his rocks, and fairness matters deeply to him.
bullets: Former Boy Scout with early outdoor and survival skills
Back-to-back all-around intramural champion
Runs marathons on a whim, makes insultingly low Catan trades
Hopes to play like Kenzie: social, heartfelt, still strategic
